items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Al was playing tenor with us out there.

ctx.x: He pushed Joyce Lewis in front of me. Should have pushed Father Al in front of me. You see the thing over there? You see, now a lot of stuff that you find out to do, you didn't know.

Yeah, that's right. Yeah. You see? Because I was in that section with those outfits. Did you play with them too? And they had Al, Booker's cousin Al, Al of Washington, Al, he died in Chicago, used to play tenor. Al was playing tenor with us out there.
